text:
Benjamin Forstner, the gunsmith who patented the Forstner bit in 1874, was most likely born in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania. He later worked in Plainville, in Hartford County, Connecticut, so Hartford County is the alternative. I'm picking Allegheny because it fits my earlier Pennsylvania recollection, but I haven't verified the birthplace or the electric-motor claim.

CONFIDENCE: 50
